calls.video_title: 2008 Made Me a Millionaire. Pullbacks Like This Are Why
calls.thesis: BUY first tracked - Arista Networks is one of the seven stocks he is dollar-cost-averaging into on this dip (~10% of the basket). Its edge is software: one operating system across every switch lets a giant customer run 100,000 processors as one machine. Growth slowed for 2 years to ~16% in 2024, then sped back up almost every quarter to ~58%, its fastest in ~12 years; management guides ~40% growth next year and ~100% AI-business growth. Pitch is open Ethernet versus Nvidia's proprietary networking.
calls.base_case: AI networking demand keeps compounding as data-centre scale grows and Ethernet stays the open standard.
calls.bull_case: The ~100% AI-business growth guide proves out and Arista takes share from proprietary networking.
calls.bear_case: Nvidia bundles its own networking so tightly with its processors that Arista's open-standard pitch loses traction.
